subject.title: fix(talk): reject malformed relay audio base64

question: Should `talk.session.appendAudio` accept both valid standard and URL-safe base64 encodings, or intentionally narrow the public RPC to standard base64 only?
rationale: Current documentation promises base64 PCM without defining the alphabet, while the PR deliberately rejects base64url that current permissive decoding accepts; repository evidence cannot determine whether that compatibility break is intended.

options.title: Preserve valid variants
options.body: Strictly validate and canonicalize both standard and URL-safe base64 while rejecting malformed input, minimizing upgrade risk.

options.title: Standard base64 only
options.body: Keep the proposed restriction after auditing shipped clients and documenting the narrower RPC contract and upgrade impact.

options.title: Pause for client audit
options.body: Hold the PR until browser, Android, native, plugin, and third-party caller encodings are inventoried.

recommendation.title: Preserve valid variants
recommendation.body: Strictly validate and canonicalize both standard and URL-safe base64 while rejecting malformed input, minimizing upgrade risk.

likelyOwner.reason: VACInc was explicitly routed into the PR discussion for the affected Gateway Talk surface and is the strongest available contract-decision candidate.
